issues.message: Single-cell port at (0.01, 0.01, 0.0025) (ez) sits inside dielectric 'substrate' (eps_r=4.40) with no adjacent PEC along the z-axis. A floating single-cell port inside substrate does not couple to patch-antenna TM modes. Pass extent=<substrate_height> to create a WirePort spanning ground → patch plane (issue #71).

all dielectric(s) ['substrate'] are perfectly lossless in an open (CPML) domain. If you are measuring Q / resonance, this gives an ARTIFICIALLY infinite Q (design-guide Anti-Pattern #1, an R5 surface-metric trap) — add loss, e.g. sigma = 2*pi*f*eps0*eps_r*tan_delta. (Harmless if you are not measuring Q.)
